limitations: Requested lateral interval includes the existing yaw correction; it differs from delivered acceleration.
Native steady inverse endpoints do not claim immediately available force; each retained sample also runs the actual finite-dt tyre relaxation and body force projection.
Thirty-three inverse-force samples give demonstrated reachable examples, not a proven global optimum.
Original trim, requested support reserve, longitudinal forces and current contacts are held fixed; no future force allocation, suspension trajectory or arrest adequacy is established.

The original full Bike step is reproduced before interpreting a counterfactual. JSON serialization caveats are limited to unused non-GP fields; recorded commands, plant outputs and selected after-state values match exactly.
